says: Decision 0585 says no tooling setting, environment name or path takes FABRIKA_ or ~/.fabrika, and names KALFA_LEAK_WORDS and ~/.kalfa/leak-words as the first case, but leakgrep.sh and the tests that set it still read FABRIKA_LEAK_WORDS and ~/.fabrika/leak-words, and no .kalfa/ folder exists, so the code lags the decision. Ticket text: when the @kalfa/ci build moves leakgrep (0585 puts the leak-words move in the ci plan), read KALFA_LEAK_WORDS and ~/.kalfa/leak-words through @kalfa/config's app named kalfa, change every test that sets FABRIKA_LEAK_WORDS with it (botdraft.test.ts, botpush.test.ts, land.test.ts, the leakgrep.*.test.ts files, pr/Merge.test.ts, plancheck.draft.test.ts and plancheck.test-support.ts), and say in the pull request where the leak-words file moves for people who have it.
proof: `.decisions/0585-kalfa-is-six-domain-packages.md` (the section "No FABRIKA_ name in tooling") reads "`FABRIKA_LEAK_WORDS` becomes `KALFA_LEAK_WORDS`, and `~/.fabrika/leak-words` becomes `~/.kalfa/leak-words`"; `.agents/skills/lead/scripts/leakgrep.sh:44` reads `os.environ.get('FABRIKA_LEAK_WORDS', str(Path.home() / '.fabrika/leak-words'))`; `grep -rn KALFA_LEAK_WORDS` outside node_modules finds only 0585 and `docs/plan/quests/kalfa-config-PLAN.md`; `ls -d .kalfa` prints "No such file or directory". This is not the fact of `field/findings/2026-11-15-t1076-command-l7-never-shows-a-file-origin.json`, which is a missing law on the shown name of the settings command's person file.
cost: A person who sets KALFA_LEAK_WORDS, as the decision says, gets no leak words checked, so the leak check passes text it should refuse, until the move is built.
